description: This is an abstract base class for Spring Boot applications within the Eclipse Hono project, providing setup, deployment, startup, shutdown, and health check mechanisms for services built on Vert.x.

classes.name: AbstractBaseApplication
classes.description: An abstract class providing common startup, shutdown, configuration, and health check handling for Spring Boot applications based on Vert.x within the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: setVertx
methods.description: Sets the Vert.x instance for the application, injected via dependency injection.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Provides access to the application's configuration properties.

methods.name: setApplicationConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the application configuration properties, injected optionally.

methods.name: setHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Configures the health check server, injected optionally.

methods.name: preFlightCheck
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform checks before startup; can throw IllegalStateException.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main startup method invoked by Spring Boot, which deploys verticles, registers health checks, and manages startup timeout.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Deploys necessary verticles; can be overridden for deployment logic.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Thread-safe method to shut down the application gracefully, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Overloaded method to shut down with specified timeout and callback handler.

methods.name: stopHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Stops the health check server asynchronously.

methods.name: postRegisterServiceVerticles
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform actions after verticle deployment.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook that runs before shutdown, for resource cleanup or other shutdown activities.

methods.name: registerHealthchecks
methods.description: Registers additional health check resources with the health check server.
